name: expand-on-ask
why: The inverse of no-expansion. Asked directly, each item gains its destination and one action. Banner-shape and prose checks are relaxed for this case; the judge grades whether the detail actually arrived.
relax_why: Expansion legitimately adds lines and prose the banner-shape checks would reject. The judge still grades whether each item is present, correctly coloured, and now carries its destination and action.
ask: Now run /flight-status, and for each item expand it — tell me where it belongs and the one action that would save it.
seed: We decided this session to cache upstream responses for five minutes, because the upstream rate limit is the real constraint. That reasoning is not written down anywhere. I also put the TTL constant into src/retry.ts, uncommitted.

items.about: the five-minute caching decision, with a stated destination such as an ADR in docs/decisions/ and a concrete action to save it
the TTL constant in src/retry.ts, with a concrete action such as committing and pushing it
